mapper.sql: lectures.id, courses.id AS course_id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, courses.target_grade AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, COALESCE(sched.schedule_str, '') AS schedule, lectures.capacity, COALESCE(enrl.current_enrollment, 0) AS current_enrollment, semesters.academic_year, semesters.term, lectures.midterm_ratio, lectures.final_ratio, lectures.assignment_ratio, lectures.attendance_ratio, lectures.syllabus

JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN professors ON lectures.professor_id = professors.id JOIN users ON professors.user_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lecture_id, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS schedule_str FROM lecture_schedules GROUP BY lecture_id ) sched ON lectures.id = sched.lecture_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lecture_id, COUNT(*) AS current_enrollment FROM enrollments WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lecture_id ) enrl ON lectures.id = enrl.lecture_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM lectures
ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT FROM ( SELECT lectures.id
ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) AS filtered_lectures JOIN lectures ON lectures.id = filtered_lectures.id
ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT lectures.id, courses.id AS course_id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, courses.target_grade AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, semesters.academic_year AS academic_year, semesters.term, lectures.midterm_ratio AS midterm_ratio, lectures.final_ratio AS final_ratio, lectures.assignment_ratio AS assignment_ratio, lectures.attendance_ratio AS attendance_ratio FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN professors ON lectures.professor_id = professors.id JOIN users ON professors.user_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id WHERE lectures.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId}) ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT id, semester_id AS semesterId, course_id AS courseId, professor_id AS professorId, section_no AS sectionNo, capacity, classroom, status, midterm_ratio AS midtermRatio, final_ratio AS finalRatio, assignment_ratio AS assignmentRatio, attendance_ratio AS attendanceRatio FROM lectures WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_schedules (lecture_id, day_of_week, start_period, end_period) VALUES (#{lectureId}, #{schedule.dayOfWeek}, #{schedule.startPeriod}, #{schedule.endPeriod})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS college_id, c.code AS college_code, c.name AS college_name, d.id AS dept_id, d.code AS dept_code, d.name AS dept_name FROM colleges c LEFT JOIN departments d ON c.id = d.college_id AND d.active = 1 WHERE c.active = 1 ORDER BY c.code ASC, d.code ASC

SELECT FROM lectures
WHERE lectures.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId})
AND semesters.academic_year = #{year}
AND semesters.term = IF(#{semester} = 1, 'FIRST', 'SECOND')
ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT FROM lectures
WHERE lectures.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId}) ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name, c.credits, c.target_grade AS targetGrade, c.completion_type AS completionType FROM courses c JOIN professors p ON c.department_id = p.department_id WHERE p.user_id = #{professorId} ORDER BY c.target_grade ASC, c.name ASC
SELECT department_id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses (code, name, credits, department_id, target_grade, completion_type) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{credits}, #{departmentId}, #{targetGrade}, #{completionType})
